facts.text: The virtual job-site method comparison covers eleven method families.

facts.text: Ratings in the virtual job-site method comparison are relative judgements based on the chapter's evidence unless a number is given.

facts.text: In the virtual job-site method comparison, a rating of "Valid" under new sensor positions means that explicit geometry stays correct from any viewpoint.
